name: 大雨那天 · 人物传 VOL.8（学徒版）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP9M《大雨那天》学徒版语法命门 12 题，按 R / SR / SSR 三档标注难度。本卷的九宫格主图、看图与回读（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、对号入座、名册核对与密码显影依赖纸面图与原文，未进题库。

m5.q: Jun carried the bags all the way, ___ ?
m5.why: 陈述部分是肯定的一般过去时，反意部分用否定 + 助动词 did。

m5.q: It was ___ heavy rain that they had to stop under a tree.
m5.why: such + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句——rain 是名词。

m5.q: It ___ since early morning, and the road is still under water.
m5.why: since + 时间点 + 现在仍未停 → 现在完成进行时。

m5.q: Jie is the boy ___ never complains, however wet he gets.
m5.why: 先行词是人，且在从句中作主语，用 who。

m5.q: That is the guard to ___ Wen spoke at the gate.
m5.why: 介词 + 关系代词，指人用 whom——to whom。

m5.q: The cat ___ under the eaves did not move at all.
m5.why: 现在分词作后置定语，表主动——猫是自己坐着的。

m5.q: The longer they walked, ___ they became.
m5.why: the + 比较级, the + 比较级——两个分句都要带 the。

m5.q: Ming ___ some milk by mistake — he went white in the face at once.
m5.why: 对过去的推测用 may have done——他可能刚才喝了。

m5.q: Chen said he ___ the umbrella as soon as the rain stopped.
m5.why: 主句是过去时 said，从句里的「将来」要退成过去将来 would fix。

m5.q: If the road ___ so muddy now, they would walk much faster.
m5.why: 与现在事实相反的虚拟——从句用过去式，be 一律 were；主句 would do。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: Jun is the boy who bag was left in the rain.
It was such heavy rain that the road turned to water.
That is the man to whom she gave the key.
The cat sitting under the eaves was quite dry.
m5.why: 后面跟着名词 bag，缺的是「谁的」→ whose bag。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: They have been standing there for twenty minutes.
If I was you, I would wait for the rain to stop.
She said she would bring an umbrella.
The letter written in pencil was hard to read.
m5.why: 与现在相反的虚拟，be 动词一律用 were → If I were you。
